highlights.description: Initial GuardSQL release with a SaaS-safe parser, AST, schema validation, policy checks, formatter, and in-memory evaluator
Browser-side TypeScript package and optional SystemForge authorization adapter for application integrations

added.description: Read-only GuardSQL parser and AST for SELECT/FROM/WHERE/GROUP BY/HAVING/ORDER BY/LIMIT, CTEs, joins, nested sources, aggregate functions, and PRIORITIZE BY
Schema validation, static linting, policy checks, query analysis, safe analytics policy defaults, and field requirement extraction
In-memory evaluator for single-source filtering, grouping, aggregates, HAVING, ordering, limits, and projection
Dependency-free formatter and guardsqlfmt CLI for canonical query output, single-line formatting, and ANSI highlighting
Lightweight authorization decision helpers and optional nested SystemForge authorization adapter module
Browser-oriented TypeScript package with lexer, parser, formatter, schema validation, policy checks, tests, and generated distribution files

fixed.description: Reject AS without a following alias so malformed source aliases fail parsing and golangci-lint unparam remains clean

documentation.description: Documented query language syntax, request pipeline, schema validation, policy model, authorization, backend execution, integrations, development, and security hardening guidance

build.description: Added GitHub Actions workflows for Go CI, linting, CodeQL, Dependabot, repository metadata, and license
